description:
BAFU files 42 rows under `resources / unspecified`, a compartment that says *this is a resource* and declines to say which kind. A compartment rule mapped all of it to `Resource → Ground`, written as a default and flagged `Review recommended`. It was true of 8 of the 42 rows and wrong for the rest, which were taken out one by one: 26 land rows by their names, 7 water and biotic rows by rules of their own, and `Carbon dioxide, in air` by a manual fix moving it to `resources / in air` (#135).

The lookup applied the same rule to a caller who named BAFU. `Carbon dioxide, in air` under `resources / unspecified`, sent with `source_label="bafu-2026-v1"`, was read as a resource from the ground, the recorded decision for that row (in air) was not found, and the only candidate (Carbon Dioxide (biogenic), `Resource → Air`) was rejected for being in the wrong medium (#381). A caller who named no list was placed, because #356 already reads the compartment as `Resource` with no medium.

The compartment rule is removed and the 8 rows it was right about are placed by per-row rules in `context-manual-mapping.json`, so every BAFU row in the compartment is placed by a statement about that row. These claims pin the 8 rows, and the carbon dioxide row, to the flows they reached on the build of 19d6cc6 (shared data directory, 22 September 2026): the change is meant to move none of them. The lookup half -- a caller naming BAFU gets the dimension and no medium -- is held by tests/test_simapro_contexts.py.

expectations.title: BAFU's platinum filed as an unspecified resource is still platinum from the ground
expectations.comment: Matched by registry number on the base build. Placed by the compartment default before this change and by a per-row rule after it.

expectations.title: BAFU's iridium filed as an unspecified resource is still iridium from the ground
expectations.comment: Matched by registry number on the base build.

expectations.title: BAFU's uranium filed as an unspecified resource is still uranium from the ground
expectations.comment: Placed by a prepared correspondence on the base build, which keeps the compartment the row resolved to.

expectations.title: BAFU's shale filed as an unspecified resource is still shale from the ground
expectations.comment: Matched by label on the base build.

expectations.title: BAFU's sodium bromide filed as an unspecified resource is still sodium bromide from the ground
expectations.comment: Matched by registry number on the base build, onto a flow this project created.

expectations.title: BAFU's energy from oil filed as an unspecified resource is still crude oil from the ground
expectations.comment: Placed by a prepared correspondence on the base build, in MJ.

expectations.title: BAFU's aluminium resource correction filed as an unspecified resource still corrects aluminium from the ground
expectations.comment: A resource correction is an amount of the resource with the opposite sign, so it is placed where the resource is.

expectations.title: BAFU's iron resource correction filed as an unspecified resource still corrects iron from the ground
BAFU's carbon dioxide in air filed as an unspecified resource still reaches biogenic carbon dioxide from air
expectations.comment: The row #381 is about. The build already placed it correctly, by the manual fix that moves it to `resources / in air` and the match override that names its flow; the defect was the lookup's. Pinned so the build half cannot move while the lookup half is fixed.
